points.statement: The goal is to build an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration.
points.quote: We aim to build an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration based on the Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) peng2023rwkv, termed Restore-RWKV.

points.statement: A network architecture is introduced, and a novel block is presented as its fundamental component for feature extraction.
points.quote: In Section 3.1, we introduce the network architecture of Restore-RWKV, and in Section 3.2, we present a novel R-RWKV block as its fundamental component for feature extraction.

points.statement: Since the original design handles sequences, innovations in a block adapt it to capture global and local dependencies in images.
points.quote: Since the original RWKV peng2023rwkv is designed for processing 1D sequences, we incorporate two innovations in the R-RWKV block to adapt it for capturing global and local dependencies in 2D images.

points.statement: An attention mechanism is introduced to effectively build global dependencies in images with linear computational complexity.
points.quote: First, in Section 3.3, we introduce a recurrent WKV (Re-WKV) attention mechanism that effectively builds global dependencies in 2D images with linear computational complexity.

points.statement: A shift mechanism is introduced to accurately capture local context to enhance model performance.
points.quote: Second, in Section 3.4, we introduce an omnidirectional token shift mechanism that accurately captures local context to enhance the model performance.
